benefit_text: The scheme offers apprenticeship training in Designated and Optional Trades. Training is one year for ITI pass‑outs, two years for non‑ITI, and six to twelve months for Optional Trades. Stipends start at ₹5,000, go to ₹9,000 per month; the government adds up to 25% limited to ₹1,500.
who_can_apply: Candidates aged 14 to 35 years can apply. There is no income restriction. Apprentices from skill programmes such as DDUGKY, NULM and PMKVY are encouraged. Applicants must have an updated Aadhaar number and complete e‑KYC on the apprenticeship portal.
documents: Aadhaar Card and documents required for the chosen trade.
how_to_apply: Visit the Apprenticeship Portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Choose the Candidate option and register with mobile number, email and Aadhaar. Complete e‑KYC and mobile OTP authentication. After registration, apply for the apprenticeship on the portal.
